thread:
sophia: Quick flag 1: our embedding evals dropped on nightly after the SDK agent bump to sdk:2.8.0. Aggregate cosine similarity for embedder-v4 devset down from 0.88 -> 0.72. Possible compatibility issue with new batching micro-change.

raj: Which workloads are failing? Is this across all quant levels or only float?

sophia: Fails on quant-8 and q4_0; float32 seems unaffected. Repro script attached (ran on staging):
```
# repro snippet
from redwood import Embeddings
em = Embeddings(model="embedder-v4")
vec_old = em.embed(["what is a neural net?"])
vec_new = em.embed(["what is a neural net?"], sdk_agent="2.8.0")
# cos(vec_old, vec_new) ~ 0.72
```

tina: That smells like a change in normalization or integer scaling in the SDK agent. Did we change any post-processing in 2.8.0?

leo: I reviewed the changelog: small batching reorder + a 'fast-normalize' flag enabled by default for quant paths. We intentionally did that to reduce CPU copies. Might accidentally change rounding.

sophia: Customer impact: one large embed-based retrieval customer on dedicated reported drop in recall in nightly QA. Not yet in prod but need quick mitigation. Propose pinning SDK to 2.7.3 for the embedder-v4 model group in staging and dedicated test fleets for 6h while we revert the fast-normalize default or add a fallback.

raj: Agreed. Keep scope tight: only model-tag=embedder-v4 and fleets:staging,dedicated-test. Releases team, can we record this in the release notes and run the pin?

releases-bot: Reminder: pins are audited. Please include reason and expiry. Suggested command: `/deploy pin sdk:2.7.3 --scope=model-tag:embedder-v4 --filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test --expires=6h --reason="embedder-v4 embedding shift after sdk:2.8.0 rollout"`

deploy-bot: No conflicting pins. To apply run the command above.

leo: I'll prepare a small hotfix to flip off fast-normalize on quant paths and run embedding diffs. If that doesn't restore similarity we'll follow with a formal revert.

tina: +1 from QA. We'll run the regression suite once pin is live and push a PASS/FAIL update in 15m and 1h.

sophia: OK running the pin now. `/deploy pin sdk:2.7.3 --scope=model-tag:embedder-v4 --filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test --expires=6h --reason="embedder-v4 embedding shift after sdk:2.8.0 rollout"`

deploy-bot: Pin created ✅
- pin_id: pin-20260321-9911
- target: sdk:2.7.3
- scope: model-tag=embedder-v4, filter=fleet:staging,fleet:dedicated-test
- expires: 6h
- initiated_by: sophia

qa-bot: Running regression: embed-similarity check for embedder-v4. ETA 15m. Will post results.

raj: Action items:
- leo: open patch to toggle fast-normalize default on quant paths and run local diffs (in progress)
- QA: report 15m/1h similarity numbers (tina)
- Releases: add entry to release notes & escalate if pin extended beyond 6h (sophia)

sophia: I'll update the customer-facing incident doc and ping the account team. Marking this thread for follow-ups.
